description: Search companies using searchText input (required) and get their Levels.fyi slugs. Use this FIRST to resolve a company name (e.g. "Google", "Meta") into the slug that the benchmark tools require in their companySlugs filter. Also matches former names and aliases, so a renamed company is found under its old name. Returns an array of { name, slug } matches. If this returns no matches, fall back to search-all, which searches every entity type and applies a fuzzy fallback. REQUIRED arguments: searchText.

searchText.description: Company name to search for, current or former (e.g. "Google", "Pure Storage").

name: search-companies
